## `bin/` — Scripts and Tools

### Authentication / Session

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/login.sh` | Idempotent Midway auth + SSH tunnel manager. `--check` mode (called from `.zshrc`): validates Midway cookie silently, starts tunnel if not running. Manual mode: runs `mwinit -f`, kills old tunnel, starts new one. Tunnel is `ssh -f -N -L $PORT:localhost:$PORT $DEV_DESKTOP_HOST`. |
| `bin/assume_role` | AWS role assumption: calls `aws sts assume-role`, writes `~/.aws/credentials`, prints caller identity. |
| `bin/aws_account` | Prints current AWS account ID via `aws sts get-caller-identity`. |
| `bin/fast-aws-creds` | Caches `ada credentials print` output to `/tmp/aws_credentials_<hash>` for 900 s. Cleans up expired cache files. Falls back to fresh fetch on miss or expiry. Used as `credential_process` in `~/.aws/config`. |
| `bin/fast-kube-creds` | Caches `aws eks get-token` output to `/tmp/k8s_token_<hash>` for 600 s. On first call, injects itself as a `kubectl` exec credential plugin for the current context. |

### Setup

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/install-home.sh` | Bootstrap: `git init ~`, add remote, fetch, `reset --hard origin/main`. |
| `bin/setup/setup.sh` | Orchestrator: runs every other `*.sh` in `bin/setup/` in sorted order. Idempotent. |
| `bin/setup/dev-tunnel.sh` | macOS only. Installs/configures dnsmasq so `*.etarn` resolves to `127.0.0.1`. Writes `/etc/resolver/etarn`. Cleans up legacy `pf` rules. Requires `DEV_DESKTOP_HOST` and `DEV_DESKTOP_TUNNEL_PORT`. |
| `bin/setup/services.sh` | Syncs service definitions from `~/.services` to system locations. Linux → systemd (`/etc/systemd/system/`) + Caddy (`/etc/caddy/`). macOS → launchd (`~/Library/LaunchAgents/`). Idempotent; prepends a managed-by marker and prunes orphaned entries. |

### Git Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/git-gone` | Cleans up worktrees/branches whose work has landed. Decision: dirty → keep; clean+landed → delete branch+worktree+remote; clean+no-remote+stale (default 12 h) → delete local only; otherwise keep. "Landed" uses ancestry fast-path then `git merge-tree` slow-path to detect squash merges. Flags: `-n`/`--dry-run`, `--stale [HOURS]`. Invoked as `git gone`. |

## Services (`~/.services/`)

Service definitions are managed by `bin/setup/services.sh` and synced to system locations.

### Linux — systemd (`~/.services/systemd/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `opencode.service` | Persistent OpenCode server (`opencode serve`) on the dev desktop. Runs as `etarn`, `Restart=always`. Exposes port 9000. Configured via env vars (`OPENCODE_CONFIG`, model `amazon-bedrock/us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1`, AWS, `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT`). |
| `caddy.service` | Caddy reverse proxy (`Restart=always`). Reads `/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. |
| `caddy/Caddyfile` | Listens on `127.0.0.1:9847`. Routes: `opencode.etarn` → `127.0.0.1:9000`, `vscode.etarn` → `127.0.0.1:9001`, `etarn` → file server at `/etc/caddy/www`. All other hosts → 404. |
| `caddy/www/index.html` | Static index page served at `http://etarn:9847/`. Lists opencode and vscode service links with JS-injected hostnames. |
| `code-server.service` | code-server (VS Code in browser) on `127.0.0.1:9001`, `Restart=always`. Binary at `~/services/code-server-4.9.1-linux-amd64/bin/code-server`. |

### macOS — launchd (`~/.services/launchd/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `com.opencode.serve.plist` | Persistent OpenCode server on macOS (`/opt/homebrew/bin/opencode serve`). `KeepAlive=true`, logs to `/tmp/opencode-serve.{stdout,stderr}.log`. Same env vars as the Linux unit. |
